Callout.Name: Property Handed In
Callout.Message: Wallet handed in with identification inside.

Script.Line: I found it on the bench outside. Everything was still in it when I looked.
I did not take anything out of it. I looked and I put it back.
There is a card in it with a name on. That is why I brought it in.

Lines.Approach: It is a wallet with a name in it and no crime attached. If you have ten minutes, the owner lives round the corner.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
